# Gate perks and Spark

Every biome gate lets you pick a free perk card. Perks last for the rest of the run and are never sold in the shop.

## Perk cards

There are **28 perks**. The 11 tagged **No downside** only ever help. Most of the rest trade one thing for another, and some pairs pull against each other, like Night Owl and Daybreak: taking the opposite card evens things out again.

## Spark sources

At the first gate of a run you choose how your Spark meter charges, and that choice lasts all run. See [Spark](basics.md#spark) for what a full meter pays.
